answer_1.quote: Our data collection approach replaces the data annotation process with data generation... We built an LLM-powered assistant in the interface to help workers draft and refine comments.

answer_4.quote: We hired two experts from UpWork.com to assess the data quality... We also asked the experts to respond to the following questions for each comment using a 5-point Likert scale...
answer_4.guideline: Experts rated each comment on a 5-point Likert scale for four questions: Q1 (grammatical correctness and fluency), Q2 (human-likeness), Q3 (confidence in annotation), Q4 (need for additional context).
